authentication.why: the caller has not proved who they are, or the proof expired

authorization.why: the caller is known and this principal may not do it

policy.why: an administrator or a jurisdiction refused it, not the principal's role

entitlement.why: the plan or the seat does not carry it, so paying changes the answer

validation.why: the request itself is malformed, so nothing downstream was attempted

unsupported.why: this build, surface, model or host cannot do it at all, so paying would not help

conflict.why: someone else wrote the row first and this write would silently overwrite them

not_found.why: nothing with that identifier is readable by this caller

deleted.why: it existed and no longer does, which is not the same as never having existed

rate_limit.why: too many requests in a window, and waiting is enough

quota.why: an allowance for the period is spent, so waiting out a window does not help

provider_unavailable.why: an upstream we call on the caller's behalf is down or degraded

timeout.why: the work was started and no answer arrived inside the budget, so its outcome is unknown

network.why: the request left and the transport failed or returned something unreadable

offline.why: the request was never made, so nothing was refused and nothing was consumed

storage.why: a blob or file store refused the read or write, which is not the database failing

database.why: the system of record refused the statement or was unreachable

search.why: the retrieval backend failed, so an answer would be built on nothing

tool.why: a tool the model called failed inside its own execution

connector.why: a connected third-party account refused or failed, and the reader chose that connection

sandbox.why: the isolated execution environment failed to start, or died while running

safety.why: the request or the answer was refused on safety grounds, which no retry changes

internal.why: a defect on our side that the reader can do nothing about

unraisedCodes.why: a read of a soft-deleted row answers 404 today, so a reader cannot tell a row that was removed from one that never existed.
unraisedCodes.raisedBy: the resource read paths that consult deleted_at: apps/web/lib/services and the routes that load a single resource.

unraisedCodes.why: blob failures reach the reader as INTERNAL_ERROR, so a transient store outage looks like a defect in the product.
a retrieval backend failure is answered as INTERNAL_ERROR, so the reader is not told the answer was built without sources.
a tool failure is carried as a tool status and flattened to INTERNAL_ERROR on the wire.
unraisedCodes.raisedBy: the tool execution path in apps/web/lib/tools.

unraisedCodes.why: a third-party connector failure is answered as SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE, which reads as our outage rather than theirs.
a sandbox that fails to start answers SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE, so a quota problem and a crash look alike.
unraisedCodes.raisedBy: the code execution path in apps/web/lib/sandbox.

unraisedCodes.why: a safety refusal is carried in the answer body rather than as a code, so no log or metric counts it.
unraisedCodes.raisedBy: apps/web/lib/safety and the chat completion route.
